purpose: Check that the static screening score separates known-good from known-bad targets. Synthetic items are positive controls for the detectors, NOT evidence of validity. Real-world validity needs real labelled incidents.

label_policy.good: Widely used, actively maintained by an established organisation. Provisional: reputation, not an audit.
label_policy.bad: Only with a verifiable public source: advisory, CVE, takedown notice or vendor post-mortem. Add the source URL before the entry is counted.
